annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Offices of the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Public Security and Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Launching a Special Rectification Campaign for Car Carrier Vehicles (Jiao Ban Yun [2025] No. 48)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Transport of the PRC; Ministry of Public Security; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
annotation.venue: Ministry of Transport of the PRC
named_instruments_referenced: Highway Safety Protection Regulations (公路安全保护条例)
Road Traffic Safety Law (道路交通安全法)
Implementing Regulations of the Road Traffic Safety Law
annotation.summary_en: A joint notice from China's Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Public Security and MIIT launching a six-month campaign (July–December 2025) against illegal overloading by car-carrier trucks. It sets loading limits, enforcement and penalty rules, and steps for revoking licences. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six-month joint special rectification campaign against car-carrier overloading, July–December 2025, in four phases
Car carriers loaded beyond 6/7/9 vehicles by type are deemed illegal and barred from expressways
Road transport certificates revoked for carriers with more than 3 over-limit violations in one year
Logistics firms suspended if more than 10% of their fleet violates limits; licences revoked in serious cases
Source supervision at manufacturer loading points and penalties under the Road Traffic Safety Law
